author: Victoria E. Freile
title: Truck driver dies after crash on New York State Thruway - NewsBreak
text:
By Victoria E. Freile ,
18 hours ago
A truck driver from Tennessee died after a late-night crash on the New York State Thruway in Chautauqua County on Monday.
Here's what to know about the fatal one-vehicle crash:
Tractor-trailer left the Thruway The crash happened shortly after 10 p.m. Monday, Aug. 17, on the eastbound lanes of Interstate 90 in the town of Hanover, according to New York State Police.
A tractor-trailer hauling a 53-foot trailer was traveling east when it left the roadway and struck a guide rail, troopers said.
Dislodged truck part caused fatal crash Troopers on Wednesday revealed that it appeared that part of a fender/mudflap had sheared off a 32-foot trailer that was attached to a westbound pickup caused the crash.
The partial fender/mudflap shaft became airborne, crossed the center median and traveled directly into the path of the eastbound tractor-trailer, according to State Police. The shaft struck the driver, which caused his rig to travel off the highway.
Driver airlifted to Buffalo hospital The driver, Petros D. Liben, 54, of Bartlett, Tennessee, suffered serious injuries to his face and abdomen, according to State Police.
Liben was airlifted to Erie County Medical Center in Buffalo, where he later died from his injuries, police said.
Investigation continues State Police are continuing to investigate the crash. No additional information was immediately available.
This article originally appeared on Rochester Democrat and Chronicle: Truck driver dies after crash on New York State Thruway
